theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: When must motorcycles be submitted for official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung)?

options.text: Every two years
Every three years
Every time they are re-registered

comment: Similarly to cars, motorcycles should be inspected every two years

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: How can you tell when you need to bring your vehicle in for its next vehicle roadworthiness test?

options.text: By looking at the inspection tag on the rear license plate
By reading the entry made in the registration certificate Part I
By reading the entry in the operating manual for my vehicle

correct_answers.text: By looking at the inspection tag on the rear license plate
By reading the entry made in the registration certificate Part I

comment: The date for the next main inspection of your vehicle can be found in the certificate of registration part 1. In addition, the appointment is clearly visible on the inspection plate printed on your license plate.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You have bought a second-hand car. The official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) has just been carried out. When is it due for its next official inspection?

options.text: After two years
After one year
After three years

comment: If the main inspection of a used car has just happened, you must do the next general inspection after two years. Only for newly purchased cars, the deadline for the next general inspection is three years.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You have left your registered caravan trailer for six months during the winter on a campground. What applies as far as the official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung) is concerned?

options.text: The date indicated on the test stamp must be observed
The date indicated on the test stamp is extended by the time the caravan was stationary on the campground

correct_answers.text: The date indicated on the test stamp must be observed

comment: Even if you have parked your caravan on a campsite, you must meet the deadline for the general inspection. Technical defects, such as rust, can occur at any time and become a safety hazard if they're not repaired.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You have purchased a 3-year-old car for your own personal use. The vehicle roadworthiness test certificate is new. What is the time limit until the next roadworthiness test must be performed?
comment: The first general inspection of a passenger car takes place after three years, each subsequent general inspection takes place every 2 years.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: At what monthly interval must trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t be presented for official inspection (Hauptuntersuchung)?
comment: You have your trucks with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 3,5 t bring every 12 months for the main study.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: You have been requested to present a truck with a gross vehicle weight rating of 18 t for its vehicle roadworthiness test. What vehicle documents do you need?

options.text: Registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)
Inspection log book
Registration certificate Part II (Motor Vehicle Title)

correct_answers.text: Registration certificate Part I (Motor Vehicle Registration)

comment: With your trucks with a maximum mass of 18 t you should use the log book and the registration certificate Part I (also called registration papers) have with you.

theme_name: Rules On The Operation Of The Vehicles
question_text: What is the mandatory time interval for performing the vehicle roadworthiness test for coaches and buses?
comment: Buses and coaches drive a lot and transport people, which is why buses and coaches have to undergo a general inspection every 12 months.
